decision.reason: The pre-attempt seal replacement window can consume the irreversible attempt on a preflight population that no longer verifies, and the claimed CuPy backend identity is a resolver result rather than the effective frozen-model execution path.

p1_findings.title: Adjacent pre-attempt check does not revalidate the sealed preflight population
p1_findings.evidence: Lines 194-196 perform a full nested verification only before semantic parsing. Lines 229-232 later compare the preflight.json SHA and the SHA of SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256, but do not recompute SHA256SUMS or any sealed member. A temporary-directory attack changed RUN_COMPLETE.txt after the first verification: the r5 second pair comparison remained true while a full double-seal verification failed.
p1_findings.impact: The runner reaches mkdir of the irreversible attempt. The producer rejects the broken seal only after attempt consumption, and the contract explicitly forbids restoring authorization after failure.
p1_findings.repair: Immediately before mkdir of the attempt, rerun sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS and sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS.seal.sha256, then compare both externally reviewed SHAs. Permit no parsing or unrelated command between that complete recheck and attempt creation. Add the reproduced mutation as a regression test.

p1_findings.title: CuPy resolver identity is not the effective backend identity required by M680
p1_findings.evidence: The manifest candidate calls resolve_snn_backend(config) and records resolved=cupy plus package version. SpikingJelly set_backend changes only matching modules with a backend attribute. The frozen overlay has PSN_COUNT=0 and 105 ATLIFTernaryPSN modules; ATLIFTernaryPSN executes torch.addmm and is not proved to consume CuPy. Thus the field called snn_backend_identity does not establish the actual execution backend.
p1_findings.impact: M680's explicit actual-backend provenance gate remains open and the receipt can misdescribe the arithmetic implementation used by the replay whose bit-exact sentinel is central to admission.
p1_findings.repair: Record the effective frozen module inventory and source identities: zero mutable PSN backend targets, 105 ATLIFTernaryPSN modules, torch.addmm implementation, actual class/source SHA and live float32-matmul controls. Label CuPy only as installed/resolver-requested, not executed, unless a real target is enumerated.
